blind.description: A stylized stone ossuary shrine consisting of an arched stone frame framing an arrangement of skulls and crossed bones, with a central medallion featuring three clustered skulls and five larger skulls ringing the upper arch. Below the bone relief is a stone altar shelf bearing a row of five thick wax candles with black wicks, resting on a sturdy molded stone pedestal base. The reverse side shows clean, solid masonry stone backing.
blind.from_above: Shows the thick arched stone back wall, the rounded top curves of five protruding skulls, five small candle tops with wicks, and the rectangular shelf of the altar extending forward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the figure (around 3.8 to 4 feet tall) and roughly 3.5 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.48x off the catalog (5.4 x 3.4 ft)
